name: Classical Persian
classification: Western Iranian language, Iranian branch of the Indo-Iranian subdivision of the Indo-European languages
region: Fars in southwestern Iran, later used in many eastern courts across Greater Iran

peakSpeakers.note: Native speakers of Persian as a whole, Wikidata figure for 2019. It is not a count for the classical stage alone.

origin: Persian is a continuation of Middle Persian, an official language of the Sasanian Empire (224 to 651 CE), which itself continued Old Persian. It originated in the region of Fars in southwestern Iran. New Persian literature was first recorded in the ninth century, after the Muslim conquest of Persia, and has since used the Perso-Arabic script.
